limitations.summary: No multi-line phrase search: all modes match per line; normalized mode normalizes per line
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: add phrase mode over whole-text normalized matching with (start_line,end_line) span locators

limitations.summary: Folders are not indexed; intentional Obsidian folder links are classified 'broken' (false-positive class behind F-0003's 175 broken links)
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: index directories, resolve folder targets as 'folder' kind, keep genuinely-missing targets broken

limitations.summary: Anchor checks re-parse the target file on every link (_heading_exists -> extract_structure per check); O(links x file parses) makes vault-wide checks needlessly slow; Master AI has never been link-checked
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: per-run structure/text cache keyed by resolved path

limitations.summary: inline_math_count recount uses a second, naive fence-skip that disagrees with the authoritative fence/math state machine in unclosed-fence files (the 14 F-0002 files) and does not skip math-block lines
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: compute inline math from the authoritative machine's line classification (safe: inline_math_count is NOT used by kuextract segmentation, so committed batches regenerate identically)

limitations.summary: Setext headings (===/--- underlines) are not detected; kuextract classifies the underline as excluded horizontal rule and setext text as prose
limitations.evidence: src/vault_unification/mdextract.py:28 (_HEADING_RE is ATX-only); kuextract.py docstring documents the limitation
limitations.fix: deferred: changing heading detection would shift committed batch segmentation; re-assess at REGEN-001 with a corpus scan for setext usage first

limitations.summary: Percent-encoded internal Markdown link URLs are matched literally; block references checked by substring '^{id}' which can false-positive in prose/code
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: strict block-id regex (line-anchored ^[id] in block position) — percent-decoding deferred pending evidence of real encoded links in the corpus

limitations.summary: term_stats counts substrings (casefolded), not word-boundary matches: 'ridge' counts inside 'bridge'; inconsistent with overlap.py word-boundary semantics that exist precisely because of F-0006
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: add word-boundary match mode to term_stats (default unchanged for backward compatibility)

limitations.summary: No atomic writes anywhere: reports, manifests and KU batches are written with plain open(...,'w'); a crash mid-write leaves a truncated file that can be mistaken for a real artifact
limitations.fix: FRAME-001: atomic_write_text helper (temp file in same dir + fsync + os.replace) routed through all writers

limitations.summary: TOCTOU window: paths are resolved at check time; a symlink appearing between check and write would be followed. Low practical risk in this single-writer environment
limitations.fix: documented + mitigated by atomic-write temp files created inside the (already checked) parent dir; full O_NOFOLLOW hardening deferred as not worth the portability cost now

limitations.summary: No concurrent-run lock: two simultaneous extract/kureg-load/report runs on the same outputs can interleave
limitations.evidence: no lock implementation exists in src/
limitations.fix: accepted for the current single-agent operating model (AGENTS.md orchestrator owns integration); revisit if parallel subagents ever write shared state

limitations.summary: Binary detection is a NUL-byte-in-first-8KB heuristic; a text file with an early NUL would be skipped, a binary file with no NUL in the first 8KB would be scanned
limitations.fix: accepted-documented (vaults are 100% markdown; no binary files exist in either manifest)

limitations.summary: NO emergent-concept / knowledge-gap discovery capability exists: CAP-013 finds cross-vault PAIRS from a given term map; it cannot propose concepts, detect unexplained prerequisites, fragmented derivations, rare essentials, homonyms, or contradictions; no candidate schema, no statuses, no fixtures
limitations.evidence: src/vault_unification/overlap.py (pair evidence only); no discovery module; schemas/ has no candidate schema
limitations.fix: DISC-001: new discovery module + concept-candidate schema + CLI + synthetic fixtures with precision/recall measurement

limitations.summary: 55 task-local scripts accumulate repeated ad-hoc logic (X2 machine-locator in ext010, fidelity checkers, term-map verifiers) that should live in the framework instead of being re-implemented per task
limitations.evidence: scripts/ directory listing; EXT-009 R2 and EXT-010 X2 improvements were per-task code
limitations.fix: FRAME-001 migrates the machine-locator utility into the framework; DISC-001 reuses it for evidence locators; remaining scripts stay as one-time migration tooling per disposition
